original_test_intent: Verify the dedicated management USB path from the BMC to the intended BF4 device's hub and, according to the Procedure, the entire expected downstream function set, without confusing another accelerator/DPU hub or a generic root hub for the BF4 path.
original_method: Identify the exact BF4 by serial/PN/slot/BDF or vendor management identity and map the BMC USB controller/root port through board/connector/cable to its hub; define the authoritative enumeration endpoint, hub port and stable descriptor identity plus each expected downstream interface; have an operator inspect/photograph the BF4 route; collect a complete unfiltered topology and descriptors with reset/flap/error logs; compare port and speed against the BF4-specific manifest; preserve BMC/BF4 management state without USB reset, rebind, authorization change, firmware action or retry.
manual_activity: An operator confirms the installed BF4 identity and slot, inspects/photographs its BMC USB cable/connectors, and ensures the management path is not serviced or replugged during read-only collection.
required_inputs: BF4 meaning plus exact device serial/PN/slot/BDF or management identity and population state
BMC USB controller/root-port/board/connector/cable-to-BF4-hub topology and enumeration owner
Expected BF4 hub and per-port downstream VID:PID/product/serial/class/speed manifest
Decision on hub-only versus all-child acceptance, N/A policy, error limits and recovery
safety_requirements: Bind evidence to the intended BF4 and distinguish any other identical accelerator/DPU hubs
Use only read-only complete topology/descriptor/log collection
Do not unplug/replug, deauthorize, reset, unbind/rebind, change firmware, power-cycle or otherwise alter BF4 management USB state
Preserve BMC/BF4 management, USB errors and evidence; do not clear logs
Stop on identity ambiguity, management degradation, reset storm, speed downgrade, child flapping or device movement; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Validate BF4 identity/population, BMC-to-BF4 physical/logical route, enumeration surface and exact hub/child oracle
After operator path confirmation, capture full tree/descriptors plus BMC/BF4/USB health and error evidence
Compare every expected child identity, port and speed, recording absent, unexpected, moved or downgraded functions
Do not substitute another hub, use insecure/truncated output, alter BF4/USB state or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Define the exact BF4 identity and resolve whether PASS needs the hub only or every Procedure-required child
Approve BMC root-port/connector route, authoritative enumeration surface and BF4-specific per-port descriptor/speed manifest
Review physical, topology, downstream and health evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Complete `lsusb -t` and descriptors can support the read-only portion if collected on the mapped owner. `grep/head` discards the BF4 path and children, while password exposure and disabled host-key checking are not acceptable.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect authenticated full USB topology, mapped hub/child descriptors and complete kernel/management error evidence on the approved endpoint, correlated to the operator-confirmed BF4 device and route.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC-to-BF4 USB hub scope, AI_VR_USB_BMC_to_BF4 bundle and 30/30-minute allocation remain; BF4 identity, hub and child oracle are not inferred.

modernized_recommendation.status: LOW READ-ONLY BF4-IDENTITY-BOUND USB MANAGEMENT HUB CHECK
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Anchor the route to a stable BF4 device identity, then validate exact hub location, per-port downstream functions and link speeds against a BF4-specific manifest.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds BF4 instance/population, other-device exclusion, port-level children, speed/error evidence and explicit acceptance conflict handling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A root hub or another accelerator's hub can appear in generic output, and BF4 hub enumeration does not prove that its required management interfaces are present.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Resetting or rebinding a BF4 management USB function can remove telemetry, firmware/service interfaces or recovery access even if the dataplane stays online.

project_override_considerations: The project must define what BF4 denotes and how to identify it. If absent by approved configuration, apply an explicit N/A policy; never substitute another board. A host view is valid only through documented BMC-path mapping.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization, acceptance decision and BF4 serial/PN/slot/BDF or management identity
Complete authoritative USB tree and full descriptors for the exact hub and all expected BF4 children with ports/speeds
BF4-specific manifest comparison including absent, unexpected, moved or downgraded functions
Pre/post BMC/BF4/USB reset/flap/error/health evidence and stable management state
Conflict disposition, discrepancy/recovery record and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Procedure requires all BF4 downstream devices to be shown, while Criteria declares PASS from hub detection alone. Hub presence cannot demonstrate complete BF4 management-function coverage.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The BMC-to-BF4 path is reviewable and both scopes can be evidenced. BF4 definition and acceptance resolution are supplyable engineering inputs.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2172 Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00059-V002: define the exact BF4 device/identity and decide hub-only versus hub-plus-all-downstream acceptance; approve population/N-A policy, BMC controller/root-port/board/connector/cable route, enumeration surface, per-port hub/child VID:PID/product/serial/class/speed oracle, error limits, aborts, and recovery.

review_improvement: Binds the generic acronym and USB evidence to one BF4 instance, preserves full child coverage, and prevents another hub or incomplete BF4 function set from yielding a false pass.
independent_technical_reasoning: The source's BF4 label is not enough to identify a device in a multi-accelerator platform. Static review must therefore require stable board/slot identity and a route map before interpreting USB output. The Procedure extends beyond hub presence to downstream functions; a hub-only pass would miss absent BF4 management interfaces. This creates a source conflict, but not an execution blocker once the owner supplies the device and per-port oracle.
